Sung Kyu Lim: adjudicated as a regular ECE professor despite his presence in the ECE 'Adjunct Faculty' group (2330). Every appointment-level official field names a regular ECE professorship: the Faculty roster (2323) lists 'Professor' with no '(ECE Adjunct)' flag; the profile (pinned and fresh) gives 'Official Job Title Professor' and the ECE endowed title 'Motorola Solutions Foundation Professor'; he appears on the ECE Endowed Chairs and Professorships list (2329); and the biography says he joined ECE in 2001 as an assistant professor and directs the GTCAD Laboratory at the School. The 2330 tag carries no adjunct title. Unlike Chou, Lin and Tumanov, no source names a primary appointment outside ECE. Under source_precedence, the specific official appointment fields outweigh a bare group tag, so the conflict is not between equally specific official claims. Treated as a likely directory tagging error, not an adjunct appointment.

Faculty home page header: 'Associate Professor, School of Computer Science, College of Computing; Adjunct Associate Professor: ECE, SCP'.
ECE directory, group filter 2329 'Endowed Chairs and Professorships', entry 'Sung Kyu Lim - Professor'.

ECE directory profile: 'Official Job Title Professor'; 'Endowed Chair and Professorships Titles Motorola Solutions Foundation Professor'; no '(ECE Adjunct)' flag; Biography: 'In August 2001, he joined the School of Electrical and Computer Engineering ... as an assistant professor. He is currently the director of the GTCAD ... Laboratory at the School.'

findings.description: Directory enumeration verified from pinned captures with parse_directory: roster list (2323, 6 pages) = 219 unique profile URLs, exactly equal to brief.expected_primary_profile_urls and the 219 required person_ids; adjunct list (2330, 2 pages) = 51 unique entries, no further pagination. 49 adjunct entries are also on the roster; 2 are adjunct-only and not required people: Kelsey Paige Kubelick (Adjunct Research Scientist II) and Jean Paul Salvestrini (Adjunct Lecturer), both excluded adjunct.

Adjunct list (2330, 51 entries) breakdown, re-parsed from pinned captures: 17 carry the '(ECE Adjunct)' flag; 27 carry explicit adjunct or research titles; 2 are adjunct-only and not required people (Kubelick, Salvestrini). Five carry plain professorial titles without the flag. Gary Stephen May (UC Davis chancellor since 2017) is excluded as adjunct. Glen Chou, Yingyan (Celine) Lin and Alexey Tumanov are excluded as adjunct, corroborated by fresh HTTPS captures showing primary appointments in SCP/AE, CS, and CS respectively; Tumanov's page explicitly says 'Adjunct Associate Professor: ECE'. Sung Kyu Lim is included as regular; see the next finding.

Sung Kyu Lim, adjudicated without leaving him unresolved: included, regular. GT ECE places him in 'Adjunct Faculty' (2330) alongside Chou, Lin, Tumanov and May, but every specific appointment field says regular ECE professor: roster 'Professor' with no adjunct flag, 'Official Job Title Professor', the ECE endowed 'Motorola Solutions Foundation Professor' with a listing on Endowed Chairs (2329, freshly downloaded), and a biography in which he joined ECE as an assistant professor in 2001 and directs GTCAD at the School. No source names a non-ECE primary appointment. The 2330 tag carries no adjunct title, so it is not an equally specific conflicting claim under source_precedence and is treated as a likely tagging error. Excluding him instead would lower the included count by 1, to 106.

No announced incoming (future-start) appointments found in the 219 profiles. Bharat Kunduri ('In Fall 2026, he joined'), Zhi Jackie Yao ('joined ... in 2026') and Vijaykrishnan Narayanan ('In August 2026, he serves as Jae S. Lim Professor') are treated as current as of the 2026-11-23 audit date, not incoming; effective_from_json is the string 'null'.

Frank Li and Brendan D Saltaformaggio: included as joint_secondary on the strength of the official ECE profile biography stating a joint SCP/ECE professorial appointment. Their generic HR job titles ('Affiliate-LongTerm Res/Collab', 'Affiliate-ShortTerm Res/Acces') are not a professorial 'affiliate/below-the-line' designation; if the policy owner reads them as explicit affiliate designations the category would instead be affiliate_professor (also included, count unchanged). Contrast Hyun Kim (same generic 'Affiliate-LongTerm Res/Collab' title, no biography or professorial claim) = excluded affiliate.

Steven W McLaughlin: the only pinned appointment evidence is 'Provost Emeritus' with a stale biography; no source establishes departure, so category emeritus (not departed) was recorded. Excluded either way. Vince D Calhoun: '(ECE Adjunct)' flag -> adjunct. A P Meliopoulos, Roger P Webb, William R Jr Callen: 'RBW' titles -> retired_working. David Richard Hertling, John W Hooper, Glenn S Smith: non-emeritus titles but explicit 'Emeritus Years of Service' fields -> emeritus.

Administrative/designation titles (Regents Entrepreneur x4, Assoc Chair-Academic, Associate Dean-Academic, School Chair, Vice Provost, Exec VP-Research, Director Academic, Provost) hide professorial rank in the directory; inclusion rests on the official ECE Faculty roster plus biography/job-title fields. Raheem A Beyah (Provost) and Paul L Voss have no explicit rank statement in their profiles beyond ECE faculty history/endowed professorship; recorded regular with lower confidence.

Changes from the earlier v5 blind audit of this job: Chou, Lin and Tumanov changed from unresolved (whose category 'unknown' was not a valid policy category) to excluded adjunct; Felix Herrmann changed from regular to joint_secondary (included either way). All other 215 records were re-checked against pinned roster, adjunct-list and profile captures and left unchanged. Stanislav Emelianov ('Professor of ECE and Biomedical Engineering') and Divya Mahajan ('Assistant Professor in School of ECE and Computer Science') stay regular; joint_secondary would also be defensible and the count would be unchanged.

Final tally: excluded/academic_professional=11; excluded/adjunct=48; excluded/affiliate=1; excluded/emeritus=38; excluded/retired_working=3; excluded/teaching=11; included/joint_secondary=8; included/regular=99. Included 107, excluded 112, unresolved 0. No incoming appointments.
